text:
Type: molded plastic dining chair
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: molded plastic shell, solid wood dowel legs, black metal cross bracing
Colors: black, light natural wood
Shape: one-piece curved bucket seat, armless, four splayed dowel legs with wire cross base, light and compact
Feel: clean, graphic, casual
Goes with: white round tables, light wood, white walls; Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: Phoenix Home Dining Chair, Single, Black
product.description: Dining chair with mid-century modern style; ideal for the dining room, living room, or general home or office use Single full-piece polypropylene plastic bucket seat molded for ergonomic comfort; matte black color Solid-wood and wire base provides strength, stability, and accenting color Non-marking feet protect floors from scratches; quick and easy to assemble Measures 21 by 18.5 by 32.5 inches (LxWxH); seat measures 17 by 18 by 17.5 inches (LxWxH)
